header.title: Avatar
header.description: A person's image with initials or an icon as fallback. Shows an optional presence status. `AvatarGroup` stacks several avatars and sums up the rest in a counter.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the avatar and its code. When there's a `status` or no name, the example passes `role="img"` and an explicit `aria-label`, because the default texts are fixed.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `src` shows the photo and `name` is used as alternative text. If the image fails to load, the initials are shown.

initials.title: Initials
initials.description: Without `src`, `name` generates the initials: the first letter of the first and last word, or the first two letters of a single word. The color comes from a hash of the name, so each person keeps theirs.

icon.title: Icon fallback
icon.description: Without `src` or `name` a user icon is shown. `icon` replaces it and `children` replaces the whole fallback. Without a name, the avatar is announced as `Avatar`: pass `aria-label`.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `xs`, `sm`, `md` (default), `lg` and `xl`. Image, initials and icon share the same scale.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` colors the fallback background: `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info` or `neutral`. Without `tone`, it's picked from `name`. Check contrast: white initials on `warning`, `success` or `tertiary` may have low contrast.

status.title: Status
status.description: `status` adds a presence dot: `online`, `offline`, `busy` or `away`. `statusPosition` places it at the bottom right (`right`, default) or centered (`centered`). The dot is visual only: the example passes `role="img"` and an `aria-label` with the status.

broken.title: Broken image
broken.description: If `src` fails, the initials or icon are shown. Changing `src` retries loading the image.

group.title: Group
group.description: `AvatarGroup` overlaps the avatars with a ring and centers the status. `max` collapses the rest into a counter and `total` sets the real count when it's larger than the children. The counter is announced as `+N more` and can't be changed; the last example builds its own counter.

tooltip.title: With tooltip
tooltip.description: Avatar has no tooltip prop: wrap it in `Tooltip`. Since the avatar isn't interactive, pass `tabIndex={0}` so the tooltip also opens with the keyboard.

person.title: Next to the name
person.description: If the name and status are already visible next to it, pass `alt=""` so the avatar is decorative and isn't read twice.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: `getAvatarInitials` and `getAvatarTone` are the functions Avatar uses. Use them to show the same initials or color in other components.

header.title: Avatar API
header.description: API reference for React Avatar and AvatarGroup: props, helpers, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `getAvatarInitials` and `getAvatarTone` compute initials and tone the same way the component does.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Avatar accepts <span> attributes except children, and they go to the root along with ref. imgProps reaches the inner <img>, except src and alt. AvatarGroup accepts <div> attributes. It only counts children that are an Avatar or wrap one, like Tooltip, and passes each size, radius, bordered and statusPosition="centered" unless set.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.image: With an image, the name comes from the <img> alt (alt or name). Without one, the root has role="img" and an aria-label.
a11y.decorative: With alt="" the avatar gets aria-hidden. Use it when the name is already visible next to it.
a11y.fallback: Without name or alt, the default name is "Avatar". Pass a descriptive aria-label.
a11y.status: The status dot has aria-hidden. Without an image, the raw status is appended to the name ("Ana, online"). With an image it isn't announced. Pass role="img" and an aria-label with the status.
a11y.group: AvatarGroup has role="group" but no name: pass it an aria-label.
a11y.overflow: The max counter is announced as "+N more" and can't be changed. To translate it, skip max and add your own Avatar with the number and an aria-label.
a11y.contrast: Initials are white on the tone color. On warning, success and tertiary contrast may fall below 4.5:1; the automatic tone can pick them too.
a11y.focus: Avatar isn't interactive. If you add a tooltip, pass tabIndex={0} so it can be focused.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.size: Size: `--xs`, `--sm`, `--md`, `--lg` or `--xl`. Sets the size variables.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`. Draws a ring with `--gem-avatar-ring`.
rules.hasImage: Applied when the image is shown.
rules.face: Clipped wrapper for the image or fallback. Receives `classNames.face`.
rules.groupItem: Wrapper for each avatar in the group. Overlaps the avatars.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Avatar's own variables. The size class sets them, so override them with `.gem-avatar.your-class`.

items.--gem-color-bg: `bordered` ring, group ring and status dot border.
items.--gem-space-2: Overlap between avatars in the group.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: They also accept their element's attributes (see Inheritance).

items.src: Image URL. If missing or broken, initials or icon are shown.
items.name: Person's name. Generates initials, tone and accessible name.
items.alt: Accessible name. Defaults to `name`. With `""` the avatar is decorative.
items.tone: Fallback color. Without a value, computed from `name`, or `neutral`.
items.statusPosition: Dot position. In `AvatarGroup` the default is `centered`.
items.bordered: Draws a ring in the background color.
items.icon: Replaces the icon when there's no image or initials.
items.children: Custom fallback. Replaces initials and icon.
items.imgProps: Extra props for the ``, such as `loading` or `onError`.
items.role: Root role. Without an image it's `img`.
items.aria-label: Root accessible name. Pass it with `role="img"` to announce the status your way.
items.ref: Root ref. `Tooltip` uses it for positioning.

items.children: Avatars to stack. They can be wrapped in a `Tooltip`.
items.size: Size for avatars that don't set one.
items.radius: Radius for avatars that don't set one.
items.max: Visible avatars before the counter. Without a value, all are shown.
items.total: Real number of people, when larger than the children.

items.initials: Initials of the first and last word, or the first letters of a single word, uppercased.
items.tone: Stable tone from the name, among `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `success`, `warning` and `info`.
